title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten distinct, documented study environments across Salisbury University Libraries, with access details and specific work-friendly features.

cards.title: Third Floor South Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Guerrieri Academic Commons · third floor
cards.notes: Take the main elevator to floor three, enter the South Reading Room, and use its book-stack setting for a quiet individual work session.
cards.short_summary: A named third-floor reading room beside the A–HF general collection.
cards.evidence_claim: SU’s wayfinding page identifies the Third Floor South Reading Room as the location for book stacks with call numbers A–HF; the library designates third-floor stacks areas as quiet spaces.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Guerrieri Academic Commons; use during regular building hours and comply with the library’s quiet-space expectations.

cards.title: Third Floor North Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Guerrieri Academic Commons · third floor
cards.notes: Exit the main elevator on floor three, turn right through the double doors, and set up near the HF–Z general-collection stacks.
cards.short_summary: A named reading room paired with the HF–Z portion of the general collection.
cards.evidence_claim: SU’s wayfinding page identifies the Third Floor North Reading Room and locates the HF–Z general-collection shelves there; third-floor stacks areas are designated quiet spaces.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Guerrieri Academic Commons; use during regular building hours and comply with the library’s quiet-space expectations.

cards.title: Guerrieri Academic Commons Study Carrels
cards.subtitle: Guerrieri Academic Commons · third floor
cards.notes: Reserve an enclosed desk for focused solo work, or check the first-come carrels when a reservation is not needed.
cards.short_summary: Partially enclosed individual desks in quiet third-floor areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The GAC has 28 reservable third-floor study carrels plus first-come carrels; they are enclosed desks located in quiet areas and may be reserved for up to 14 days.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Study Room or Carrel
cards.access_notes: Reservable carrels are on the third floor; additional carrels are first come, first served. Check the online availability schedule before relying on a reserved seat.

cards.entity_name: Guerrieri Academic Commons Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Guerrieri Academic Commons Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Guerrieri Academic Commons · second floor
cards.notes: Book a room sized for four, eight, or ten and bring a device to share work on the room’s TV and whiteboard.
cards.short_summary: Reservable second-floor rooms for small and larger group work.
cards.evidence_claim: SU lists 13 second-floor GAC group study rooms in small, medium, and large sizes for up to 10 people; rooms include a TV and at least one whiteboard.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Study Room or Carrel
cards.access_notes: Study rooms are reservable by SU students, faculty, and staff. Use the room scheduler; unreserved rooms are first come, first served.

cards.entity_name: Guerrieri Academic Commons First-Floor Study Rooms
cards.title: Guerrieri Academic Commons First-Floor Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Guerrieri Academic Commons · first floor
cards.notes: Check first-floor rooms directly for availability when you need a group workspace without arranging a second-floor reservation.
cards.short_summary: First-floor group rooms available on a first-come basis.
cards.evidence_claim: SU Libraries states that first-floor GAC study rooms are available first come, first served, while second-floor rooms can be reserved online.
cards.access_notes: First-floor rooms are first come, first served. Study rooms have no computers, so bring a device or check out a laptop from the Library Service Desk.

cards.title: GAC Classroom 117
cards.subtitle: Guerrieri Academic Commons · first floor
cards.notes: Look at the availability tablet before settling in; when no library workshop is scheduled, use this technology-enabled classroom as study space.
cards.short_summary: A library classroom that becomes student study space between scheduled uses.
cards.evidence_claim: SU identifies AC 117 as a technology-enabled library classroom and states that classrooms AC 117, 162, and 163 are open as student study spaces when not in use.
cards.access_notes: Available only when not in use during regular GAC hours; current availability is displayed on the tablet outside the room.

cards.title: GAC Classroom 162
cards.subtitle: Guerrieri Academic Commons · first floor
cards.notes: Use the tablet outside the door to confirm the room is open, then take advantage of the classroom setting for a longer work block.
cards.short_summary: A technology-enabled GAC classroom with conditional study access.
cards.evidence_claim: SU identifies AC 162 as a technology-enabled library classroom and states that classrooms AC 117, 162, and 163 are open as student study spaces when not in use.
cards.access_notes: Available only when not in use during regular GAC hours; current availability is displayed on the tablet outside the room.

cards.title: GAC Classroom 163
cards.subtitle: Guerrieri Academic Commons · first floor
cards.notes: Confirm the posted schedule before entering and use the open classroom for study when no workshop, event, or course reservation is active.
cards.short_summary: A technology-enabled classroom that can serve as study space when vacant.
cards.evidence_claim: SU identifies AC 163 as a technology-enabled library classroom and states that classrooms AC 117, 162, and 163 are open as student study spaces when not in use.
cards.access_notes: Available only when not in use during regular GAC hours; current availability is displayed on the tablet outside the room.

cards.title: Jim & Carol Powers Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Dr. Ernie Bond Curriculum Resource Center · Conway Hall
cards.notes: Head to the CRC in Conway Hall and use this named reading room when you want a quiet setting alongside curriculum materials.
cards.short_summary: A quiet reading room within Salisbury’s Curriculum Resource Center.
cards.evidence_claim: SU describes the Jim & Carol Powers Reading Room as one of the CRC spaces where students and faculty can study quietly, individually or in small groups, or relax.
cards.access_notes: The CRC welcomes all SU students, faculty, and staff; it is located in Conway Hall, room TE 226.

cards.entity_name: Guerrieri Academic Commons Cyber-Café Study Space
cards.title: Guerrieri Academic Commons Cyber-Café Study Space
cards.subtitle: Guerrieri Academic Commons · two-story cyber-café
cards.notes: Use the cyber-café’s designated study area for a change of scenery, keeping in mind that dining service and study access can differ.
cards.short_summary: A two-story campus cyber-café with a documented 24-hour study area.
cards.evidence_claim: Salisbury University’s campus facilities page states that the GAC’s two-story cyber-café provides dining as well as 24-hour study space.
cards.access_notes: The university documents 24-hour study space in the two-story cyber-café; confirm building access requirements, as GAC entry can require a Gull Card during certain hours.
